ui.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved.
ui.emptyMessage: An automation watches for something happening in your business and then does something about it — on its own, every time.
ui.deleteMessage: It stops running immediately. Its history stays as the record that it existed.
ui.noAccessMessage: Automations can run commands while nobody is watching, so this module only reaches them if you allow it. Go to Settings → Permissions and turn on “Manage automations” for Automations.
ui.unsupportedTitle: This hub cannot do automations yet
ui.unsupportedMessage: The automation kernel arrived in a newer version of the hub. Update the hub and this editor will find it.
ui.notAdminTitle: Only an owner or an administrator can edit automations
ui.notAdminMessage: An automation acts in the name of the business without anybody watching, so deciding what it may do is not something a shift session can approve.
ui.triggerKindAt: Once, at a date and time
ui.eventNotInHub: This hub does not have it — it comes with the {module} module
ui.eventNoSamples: No examples yet: nothing like this has happened here in the last 90 days
ui.eventOtherHint: Type the exact name of an event this hub emits.
ui.stepUnsupported: A “{kind}” step, which this editor cannot edit yet
ui.readOnlyStep: This step keeps working. Editing it needs a newer version of this module.
ui.noSteps: No steps yet. Add the first thing this automation should do.
ui.commandHint: The name of a command in this hub, for example sales.sale.create. You will be asked to allow it before it can run.
ui.guardExplain: If this is not true the automation stops here. It does not do anything else — there is no second path.
ui.opInHint: Separate the values with a comma.
ui.pickFieldSearch: Search by name or by value
ui.pickFieldNoSamples: This hub has not seen this happen recently, so there are no examples to show. The fields are still the right ones.
ui.pickFieldRedacted: example hidden: it could be about a person
ui.grantsIntro: An automation runs with its own permissions, never with yours. Nothing below happens until you allow it.
ui.grantsNone: This automation asks for nothing yet.
ui.grantCommandNotFound: This hub has no command called {command}. Check the name in the step.
ui.runWaitingApproval: Waiting for you to approve it
ui.ranGuardStopped: The condition was not met, so it stopped here. That is the automation working.
ui.runStarted: It is running. Its result appears here in a moment.
ui.evKitchenOrderReady: the kitchen has an order ready
ui.evStockChanged: the stock of a product changes
ui.pickFieldSkipArray: not offered: it is a list, and an automation cannot reach inside one
ui.pickFieldSkipObject: not offered on its own: pick one of the fields inside it
